decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 13/08/2013, the proposal as shown on the drawing submitted on 04/07/2013 and numbered 80HOG001-1, 80HOG001-2, 80HOG001-3, 80HOG001-4, 80HOG001-5, 80HOG001-6, 80HOG001-10, Unnumbered location plan, Unnumbered block plan and as verified on site was not lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development fails to comply with the terms of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class B, Clause(s) B.1 (c) (ii) and B.2 (b) of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (as amended in 2008) because the cubic content of the resulting roof space would exceed he cubic content of the original roof space by more than 50 cubic metres and the rear roof extension would be less than 20 centimetres from the eaves of the original roof.
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the proposed erection of a rear roof extension incorporating hip to gable conversion, two front roof lights and two side windows to the house
